alerts.text: Claude Design now counts against your normal usage
alerts.dashboardText: Anthropic overhauled Claude Design on June 17. Key changes: Design now draws from your shared usage limits instead of its own pool (far fewer tokens per turn), bidirectional Claude Code sync so designs hand off cleanly to code, design system imports from GitHub or uploaded files, and a rebuilt canvas editor for direct tweaks. Available on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise. Tap to learn more.

The US Commerce Department has lifted export controls on Fable 5 and Mythos 5. Fable 5 access resumes globally today on Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Cowork; Mythos 5 is restored for approved US organizations. On Pro, Max, Team, and select Enterprise plans, Fable 5 is included for up to 50% of your weekly usage limits through July 7 — after that it draws on usage credits. Tap to read Anthropic's statement.

alerts.text: Claude Sonnet 5 is here — intro pricing through Aug 31
alerts.dashboardText: Claude Sonnet 5 is now the default model on Free and Pro, and available on Max, Team, and Enterprise. Introductory pricing of $2/$10 per million input/output tokens runs through August 31, then moves to $3/$15. Note: Sonnet 5's new tokenizer can use up to 1.35× more tokens for the same text — pricing is calibrated to keep costs roughly cost-neutral. Tap to read more.
